name: HZ_CUST_SITE_USES_ALL
description: The HZ_CUST_SITE_USES_ALL table stores business purposes  assigned to customer account sites, for example Bill-To, Ship-To, and  Statements. Each customer account site can have one or more purposes.  This table is a child of the HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL table, with the foreign  key CUST_ACCT_SITE_ID. The HZ_CUST_SITE_USES_ALL table also stores operating  unit identifier, though the HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL table itself stores the  operating unit for customer account sites.
